name: playthrough-chain-pf
purpose: iter-465 playthrough lane (docs/PLAYTHROUGH.md): walk the story spine past the Warworld return with the level-skip dev tool, PORT FEATURES ON (custom front end + autosave; natural=false). Title -> START -> custom MAIN MENU -> NEW GAME (mouse) -> main_hud -> the plan (archive/v1_playthrough/plans/pf_*.txt, made by tools/devtools/skipplan.py --carrier auto + holds) runs the game's own objectives chapter by chapter; the autosave port feature answers save prompts Continue Without Saving while the skip is armed. Ends at the plan's end (done/timeout/aborted), a crash marker, or the timeout; then holds 180 s to see what the game does by itself. Tag: dev-tool assisted. Gates: -Gates "SR_INSTANCE_ID=playthrough,SR_PORT_FEATURES=1,SR_DEVTOOLS=levelskip,SR_DEVTOOLS_CMDS=<abs plan>,SR_DEVTOOLS_OUT=<dir>,SDL_AUDIODRIVER=disk". -TimeoutSeconds 3600.

steps.name: plan-end
steps.purpose: the plan ends (done = the target was won) or stops; or a crash marker

steps.name: after-hold
steps.purpose: what the game does by itself after the plan (frames)
